title: Fifthbell redirect page input
description: An active redirect intent as Ariston records it (gaulatti/ariston#211). The page is written at fromKey and sends the reader to toRoute on the public site. Only an active intent renders: a retired one (route_reclaimed, target_withdrawn) is refused so no redirect is written. Routes are site paths, never URLs. Keys Brokaw does not know are ignored.

route.description: An article route: an optional es/it prefix, then lowercase ASCII segments. It always starts with one slash, so it can only add a path to the site origin.
